answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable work bond before it can earn, sized to the zenith of its claimed throughput: one identity, one bond. A newcomer starts on the terrace, with low limits until it completes verified jobs, so a sybil farmer must fund thousands of bonds to fake scale. Pair this with a lotus-style reputation that blooms only from completed, attested work and wilts on disputes, so copies cost more than they earn while honest agents keep their stake.
